title: Automated Violation Detection & Monitoring System
summary: A full-stack traffic enforcement system built to detect violations from live camera feeds, manage violation tickets and automatically generate challans.
challenge: Traffic violations needed to be detected and processed in real time without relying on a manual workflow for every event.
solution: Built a command-line automation tool to detect traffic violations in real time using live camera feeds.
Developed a responsive admin panel for managing violation tickets and monitoring enforcement activity.
Automated challan generation for detected violations.
Used Laravel, React.js, MySQL and AWS to support the application and its data workflow.
outcomes: Over 70% reduction in manual processing time.
Improved real-time traffic law compliance monitoring.
Reduced manual workload through automated violation and challan processing.
